verdict.rationale: Rippling explicitly supports adding one-off bonuses to payroll and running payroll on any schedule at no extra charge, which directly covers off-cycle/bonus runs. However, there is no explicit documentation of off-cycle runs specifically for terminations or corrections, nor any independent/hands-on confirmation of the off-cycle workflow itself. missing for 10: explicit documentation of termination/final-pay off-cycle runs, correction-run workflow details, and independent verification of off-cycle payroll execution.
